answer_verbatim:
If you want the **best online courses** for **shadow work**, the strongest options in the results are the more structured offerings from **Jung Platform**, **Charlie Morley/Awake Academy**, **ManTalks**, and **Catherine Liggett**, because they present shadow work as a guided, curriculum-based process rather than just prompts or a workbook.[3][7][14][16][18]

For **spiritual practice** alongside shadow work, courses that explicitly include meditation, prayer, or reflective practice—such as the **Udemy shadow work course and workbook** and the **Insight Timer** offering—look the most aligned with your goal.[11][19]

Here’s a practical shortlist:

| Course | Best for | Why it stands out |
|---|---|---|
| **Encounters with the Shadow** (Jung Platform) | Jungian depth work | An in-depth introduction to Jungian shadow work, with a focus on patterns and psychologically grounded self-observation.[3][7] |
| **Embracing the Shadow** (Awake Academy / Charlie Morley) | Spiritual + contemplative shadow work | Positioned as a transformative course and taught by a known teacher in this space.[18] |
| **Shadow Course: Discover Your Hidden Potential** (ManTalks) | Guided integration process | An 8-week guided process designed to face and integrate the shadow.[16] |
| **Shadow Work | Online Courses** (Catherine Liggett) | Live, structured support | A 5-week live online course via Zoom, which may be useful if you want real-time guidance.[6] |
| **Shadow Work Course and Workbook** (Udemy) | Self-paced practice | Includes lessons, exercises, meditations, prayers, and practices for spiritual transformation.[11] |
| **Shadow Mastery Course & Exercises** (Centre of Excellence) | General self-development | A reflective journey inspired by Jungian psychology and modern personal development.[4] |

A few notes to help you choose:
- If you want the most **psychologically grounded** option, start with **Jung Platform**.[3][7][14]
- If you want the most **spiritually oriented** option, **Charlie Morley / Awake Academy** and the **Udemy course with meditations and prayers** fit best.[11][18]
- If you want **live accountability**, choose **Catherine Liggett’s** 5-week Zoom course.[6]
- If you want a more **affordable self-paced route**, Udemy-style courses are usually the simplest entry point, though quality can vary by instructor.[2][11][12][15]

- **best for beginners**
- **best for spiritual awakening**
- **best for Jungian psychology**
- **best free or low-cost options**
